newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Greenspan, Trichet cancel IMC press briefing.
newsitem.headline: Greenspan, Trichet cancel IMC press briefing.

text.p: Alan Greenspan, chairman of the U.S. Federal Reserve, and Jean-Claude Trichet, governor of the Bank of France, will not attend a press briefing as originally planned at the International Monetary Conference (IMC), organisers said.
A spokeswoman for the organisers, the American Bankers Association (ABA), told Reuters that both central bankers had to leave before the press briefing due to travel arrangements.
The press briefing was planned to take place around 0930 GMT and follow a panel discussion between top central bankers and around 100 leading commercial bankers.

"I just found out this morning...it was discussed at the (central bank) panelists' breakfast this morning," she said, adding: "I was told that he (Greenspan) had to leave early because of travel arrangements."
"Regarding Trichet, I found out a couple of days ago his travel arrangemens are such that he had to leave early and can not participate in the press briefing," she said.
